PILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT OILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue. West Triangle. Quezon City http: //www. dilg.gov.ph OPINION No. MAYOR RENE B. BORENAGA Municipality of Bien Unido Province of Bohol Dear Mayor Borenaga: S. 20 lg This has reference to your letter dated 15 January 2018 seeking for enlightenment on the possible status of your position and that of Vice-Mayor Ramon R. Arcenal. Per your letter, you alleged that after the incident involving Mayor Gisela Bendong- Boniel last June 7, 2017, you and Hon. Arcenal were serving as Acting Mayor and Acting Vice-Mayor, respectively, of your municipality. The body of Mayor Gisela is not yet found up to this writing by the authorities despite of the earnest efforts of search and retrieval operations. Hence, your request. As held by the Supreme Court in the case of People vs. Sasotal, the claim of the appellants therein that there was no conclusive evidence of death of the victim because his body was never found was overruled by this Court in this wise: "In a case of murder or homicide, it is not necessary to recover the body or to show where it can be found. 'Mere are cases like death at sea, where the finding or recovery of the body is impossible. It is enough that the death and the criminal agency be proven. There are even cases where said death and the intervention of the criminal agency that caused it may be presumed or established by circumstantial evidence. Moreover, it may be remembered that in several treason cages decided by this Court, where besides the act of treason the accused is held responsible for the death of persons he had or tortured and later taken away, where the victims were never later seen or heard from, it has been presumed that G.R. No. L-3544 dated 18 April 1952

they were lulled or otherwise criminally disposed Ofor liquidated by the accused this, for the purpose of fixing the penalty. " It is a settled rule that circumstantial evidence is sufficient to support a conviction, and that direct evidence is not always necessary. This is but a recognition of the reality that in certain instances, due to the inherent attempt to conceal a crime, it is not always possible to obtain direct evidence. Thus, this Department is of the view that Mayor Gisela's disappearance may be considered death because of the circumstantial evidence surrounding the case. Going back to your query, assuming that Mayor Gisela is already dead, then the applicable provision that will enlighten us on your position is Section 44 (d) of the Local Government Code, to wit: "SECTION 44. Permanent Vacancies in the Offices of the Governor, Vice-Governor, Mayor, and Vice-Mayor. - If a permanent vacancy occurs in the office of the governor or Mayor, the vice-governor or vice-mayor concerned shall become the governor or Mayor. If a permanent vacancyoccurs in the offices ofthegovernor, vice-governor, Mayor, or vice-mayor; the highest ranking Sanggunian member or, in case of his permanent inability, the second highest ranking Sanggunian member, shall become the governor, vice-governor, Mayor or vice- mayor, as the case may be. Subsequent vacancies in the said office shall be filled automatically by the other Sanggunian members according to their ranking as defined herein. xxv xxx (d) The successors as defined herein shall serve only the unexpired terms of their predecessors. For purposes of this Chapter, a permanent vacancy arises when an elective local official fills a higher vacant office, refuses to assume ofFce, fails to qualify, dies, is removed from office, voluntarily resigns, or is otherwise permanently incapacitated to discharge the functions of his office. "(Underscoring given) AXY XXV Accordingly, this Department is of the considered view that the incumbent Vice- Mayor shall become the Mayor and the first ranking Sangguniang member shall become the Vice-Mayor, in view of the above-mentioned provision of the LGC. G.R. No. 187725 dated 19 Januarv2011

CC: We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, By Aut of the Secretary: AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary Atty. Rene K. Burdeos Regional Director DILG-Region VII Hon. Ramon R. Arcenal Acting Municipal Vice-Mayor Municipality of Bien Unido Province of Bohol
